description: This is a PHP unit test class for the PsrHttpFactoryHelper, testing its methods for creating and converting PSR-7 request and response objects from custom OrangeHRM HTTP request/response classes, including handling of binary file responses.

classes.name: PsrHttpFactoryHelperTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the PsrHttpFactoryHelper's methods for converting custom HTTP request and response objects to PSR-7 standard objects and vice versa, including handling of binary responses.

methods.name: testCreatePsr7Request
methods.description: Tests creation of PSR-7 requests from custom Request objects, including GET and POST methods with headers and body.

methods.name: testCreatePsr7Response
methods.description: Tests creation of PSR-7 responses from custom Response objects, including handling of headers, status code, and binary file responses.

methods.name: testCreateRequestFromPsr7Request
methods.description: Tests creation of custom Request objects from PSR-7 server request objects.

methods.name: testCreateResponseFromPsr7Response
methods.description: Tests creation of custom Response objects from PSR-7 response objects.
